physics_goals.value: Search for light WIMPs with superheated droplet detectors

summary.plain: InDEx is an Indian dark matter search using small superheated droplet detectors, 555 metres underground at Jaduguda in Jharkhand. Its first two runs found no dark matter and set limits on how strongly light WIMPs could interact.
summary.technical: Indian Dark matter search Experiment: superheated emulsion droplet detectors with C2H2F4 (tetrafluoroethane), acoustic readout. Run 1: 500 ml, 48.6 effective days at a 5.87 keV threshold, 2.47 kg d; Run 2: 1.95 keV threshold, 70.4 g active liquid, 102.48 days, constraints on spin-independent (20.4 GeV/c^2) and spin-dependent (21.0 GeV/c^2) WIMP-nucleus interactions.
